current_answer: Bruin advertises USD 10,000 in Bruin Cloud credits for two years, but the credit route is for new Bruin users backed by Y Combinator, Techstars, or Antler, with under USD 5 million institutional funding and fewer than 20 people. A self-funded team can use Bruin’s open-source CLI or free Cloud tier and may join the credit waitlist, but should not budget the USD 10,000. The issuer says no card or automatic charge; country eligibility and the application form details remain unverified.

catalogue_card.question: Can a bootstrapped startup use Bruin’s USD 10,000 credit?
catalogue_card.text: Not on the published credit route: Bruin requires backing by YC, Techstars, or Antler, under USD 5 million institutional funding, fewer than 20 people, and first-time use. Others can join a waitlist or use the free tools; the credit covers Bruin Cloud, not general cloud bills.

summary: Bruin lists USD 10,000 in Bruin Cloud credits, active for two years from grant, for qualifying backed startups.
The named backing gate is YC, Techstars, or Antler; the team must be under 20 people and under USD 5 million raised from institutional investors.
Nonqualifying teams may join a waitlist or use the open-source CLI and Cloud free tier; waitlisting is not credit eligibility.
Interledger remains paused; NLnet lists 3 November 2026, 12:00 CET.
uncertainty: Bruin country coverage, application cutoff, and live form questions were not verified.
Bruin’s 1–2-year usage estimate is not a guaranteed duration of usable credit; unused balance expires two years from grant.
Interledger remains paused; NLnet still lists 3 November 2026, 12:00 CET. Microsoft and Cloudflare issuer conflicts remain unresolved. Pool analytics are unavailable.
